Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly categorized the descriptions of gases as "states of matter" rather than "properties of matter." The characteristics mentioned (compressibility and ability to expand) are indeed properties that define the behavior and characteristics of gases, not simply the state itself. This misunderstanding led to the incorrect conclusion that the answer was B) states of matter instead of the correct answer C) properties of matter.
